f.title: Carry out the PV actions the technical standard assigns to each actor
f.statement: Pharmacovigilance is a health-control activity shared by the competent authorities, marketing authorisation holders, health professionals, public and private health-care institutions and the population; these entities must carry out the pharmacovigilance actions set out for each of them in this standard, based on current regulation, especially Supreme Decree No. 3 of 2010.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders (and other members of the National PV System)
rows.quote: Conforme a ello, las entidades indicadas previamente deberán ejecutar las acciones de Farmacovigilancia que en adelante para cada caso se indican y que se basan en la regulación vigente, especialmente aquella contenida en el Decreto Supremo N° 3, del Ministerio de Salud, referido precedentemente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Accordingly, the entities indicated above shall carry out the Pharmacovigilance actions indicated below for each case, which are based on current regulation, especially that contained in Supreme Decree No. 3 of the Ministry of Health referred to above.

f.title: Implement a documented system to collect and handle suspected ADRs
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders are ultimately responsible for the safety and efficacy of their medicines and must implement and maintain, as required by the National Regulation for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use, a documented system for collecting and handling suspected adverse drug reactions and safety information on their products, including information from importers and distributors.

rows.quote: Los titulares de registro sanitario son los responsables finales de la seguridad y eficacia de sus medicamentos y deberán implementar y mantener, de acuerdo a lo establecido en el Reglamento Nacional de Control de los Productos Farmacéuticos de Uso Humano, un sistema documentado que permita la recopilación y tratamiento de las sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos e información de seguridad generada de sus productos, incluyendo aquella proveniente de importadores y distribuidores.
data_elements: safety information from importers and distributors
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders are ultimately responsible for the safety and efficacy of their medicines and shall implement and maintain, in accordance with the National Regulation for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use, a documented system that allows the collection and handling of suspected adverse drug reactions and safety information generated on their products, including that coming from importers and distributors.

f.title: Have an own or outsourced PV system led by the Technical Director or a notified adviser
f.statement: Every holder of a marketing authorisation for medicines for human use must have a pharmacovigilance system, own or outsourced, under the responsibility of its Technical Director or, failing that, a Technical Adviser who may be a health professional; the designation of this person must be notified to the Instituto de Salud Pública (ISP).
f.processes: Safety governance; Local PV interfaces; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Todo titular de registro sanitario de medicamentos de uso humano, en función de lo expuesto, deberá disponer de un sistema de farmacovigilancia, propio o externalizado, a cargo de su Director Técnico o, en su defecto, de un Asesor Técnico, que podrá ser un profesional del area de la salud, personal cuya designación deberá ser notificada el Instituto de Salud Pública.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Every holder of a marketing authorisation for medicines for human use, in accordance with the above, shall have a pharmacovigilance system, own or outsourced, under the responsibility of its Technical Director or, failing that, a Technical Adviser, who may be a health professional, and the designation of this person shall be notified to the Instituto de Salud Pública.

f.title: Collect and evaluate ADRs and send them to ISP on authorised forms in Spanish
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must at least maintain a system that collects and evaluates information on adverse reactions notified to the marketing authorisation holder, so that they are sent to the ISP in good time on the authorised forms, always in Spanish, for the medicines the holder markets in Chile.

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Mantener un Sistema de Farmacovigilancia que permita recopilar y evaluar la información sobre reacciones adversas a los medicamentos notificadas al titular del registro sanitario, con el fin de enviarlas oportunamente al Instituto de Salud Pública, en los formularios autorizados al efecto, siempre en idioma español y para los medicamentos que comercializan en el país.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Maintain a Pharmacovigilance System that allows the collection and evaluation of information on adverse drug reactions notified to the marketing authorisation holder, in order to send them in a timely manner to the Instituto de Salud Pública, on the forms authorised for this purpose, always in the Spanish language and for the medicines they market in the country.

f.title: Prepare and send PSURs for the active substances ISP designates
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must prepare and send to the ISP periodic safety update reports for the active substances that the ISP indicates by resolution.
f.applicability: Active substances designated by ISP resolution

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Preparar y enviar al Instituto de Salud Pública los informes periódicos de seguridad para aquellos principios activos que indique el Instituto de Salud Pública mediante resolución.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Prepare and send to the Instituto de Salud Pública the periodic safety reports for those active substances that the Instituto de Salud Pública indicates by resolution.

f.title: Submit risk management plans and carry out actions ISP orders
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must submit risk management plans and carry out any actions that the ISP indicates by reasoned resolution.

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Presentar los planes de manejo de riesgo y desarrollar las eventuales acciones que le indique el Instituto de Salud Pública mediante resolución fundada.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Submit the risk management plans and carry out any actions that the Instituto de Salud Pública may indicate by reasoned resolution.

f.title: Answer ISP requests for benefit-risk information immediately
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must respond immediately to any request for information from the ISP that allows the benefits and risks of medicines to be assessed, within the time limits the ISP sets under Law 19.880 on administrative procedures.

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.deadline: Immediately, within the time limits ISP sets
rows.quote: Dar respuesta inmediata a cualquier requerimiento de información por parte del Instituto de Salud Pública que permita evaluar los beneficios y riesgos de los medicamentos, en los plazos que dicha entidad disponga
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Respond immediately to any request for information from the Instituto de Salud Pública that allows the benefits and risks of medicines to be assessed, within the time limits that this entity sets

f.title: Keep suspected ADR documentation to allow follow-up
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must keep the documentation on suspected adverse drug reactions so as to complete or carry out follow-up where necessary.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Conservar la documentación respectiva de las sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos a fin de completar o realizar el seguimiento en caso necesario.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Keep the respective documentation of suspected adverse drug reactions in order to complete or carry out follow-up if necessary.

f.title: Evaluate benefit-risk continuously and report changes immediately
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must continuously evaluate the benefit-risk balance of the medicines during the post-marketing period and immediately communicate to the competent authority any information that could imply a change in that balance.

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Realizar una continua evaluación de la relación beneficio-riesgo de los medicamentos durante el periodo de post comercialización y comunicar inmediatamente a la autoridad competente cualquier información que pudiera suponer un cambio en dicha relación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Carry out a continuous evaluation of the benefit-risk balance of the medicines during the post-marketing period and immediately communicate to the competent authority any information that could imply a change in that balance.

f.title: Collect safety information from post-marketing studies
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must collect the safety information from post-marketing studies.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote:
Recolectar la información de seguridad de los estudios post-
comercialización.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Collect the safety information from post-marketing studies.

f.title: Report on the effectiveness of RMP risk minimisation measures
f.statement: The person responsible for the pharmacovigilance system must report on the effectiveness of the risk minimisation measures included in the risk management plans.

rows.actor: Person responsible for the MAH pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: Informar respecto la efectividad de las medidas de minimización de riesgos contempladas en los planes de manejo de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Report on the effectiveness of the risk minimisation measures included in the risk management plans.

f.title: Send individual reports within the DS 3/2010 time limits
f.statement: Individual case reports must be sent within the time limits established in the Regulation of the National System for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use (DS 3/2010).

rows.deadline: As set in DS 3/2010 (not stated in this standard)
rows.quote: Los reportes individuales deberán ser enviados en los plazos establecidos en el Reglamento del Sistema Nacional de Control de Productos Farmacéuticos de Uso Humano,
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Individual reports shall be sent within the time limits established in the Regulation of the National System for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use,

f.title: Submit PSURs for innovative products 6-monthly, then yearly, then 5-yearly
f.statement: The ISP sets PSUR periodicity and the products concerned by reasoned resolution. For innovative products, the resolution granting the registration sets PSUR submission at most every 6 months during the first two years, at most annually during the following 3 years, and at most every 5 years thereafter.

rows.deadline: Every 6 months (years 1-2), annually (years 3-5), every 5 years thereafter
rows.quote: En el caso de los productos innovadores, atendida la necesidad de fortalecer los datos de seguridad de los mismos, se dispondrá para ellos, en la resolución que conceda el respectivo registro sanitario, la periodicidad de presentación de los Informes Periódicos de Seguridad, en el siguiente esquema: durante los primeros dos años, cada 6 meses como máximo; durante los siguientes 3 años, en forma anual como máximo; de ahí en adelante, cada 5 años como máximo.
rows.review_note: Review: periodic intervals, not single deadlines, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement within quote and preceding sentence of 11(e).
rows.quote_en: In the case of innovative products, given the need to strengthen their safety data, the resolution granting the respective marketing authorisation shall set for them the periodicity of submission of Periodic Safety Reports according to the following scheme: during the first two years, every 6 months at most; during the following 3 years, annually at most; thereafter, every 5 years at most.

f.title: Propose a risk management plan when ISP requests one
f.statement: In qualified cases and by reasoned resolution the ISP will request risk management plans, among others for molecules introduced to the market for the first time, biotechnological products and products similar to innovators that already have risk management plans; in these cases the applicant or holder must propose a risk management plan, which may be accepted or returned for modification.
f.applicability: New molecular entities, biotechnological products, products similar to innovators that have an RMP, when requested by ISP resolution

rows.quote: En estos casos, el solicitante o titular del registro sanitario deberá proponer un plan de manejo de riesgos, el que podrá ser aceptado o devuelto para su modificación.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In these cases, the applicant or holder of the marketing authorisation shall propose a risk management plan, which may be accepted or returned for modification.

f.title: Address immunogenicity in risk management plans for biologicals
f.statement: Risk management plans for products of biological origin must pay special attention to the risk of immunogenicity, which is characteristic of this type of product.

rows.quote: Los planes de manejo de ricsgos de productos de origen biológico deberán poner especial atención al riesgo de inmunogenicidad, característico de este tipo de productos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Risk management plans for products of biological origin shall pay special attention to the risk of immunogenicity, characteristic of this type of product.

f.title: Communicate safety information to ISP and apply for the related variation
f.statement: Every holder of a marketing authorisation for pharmaceutical products must communicate to the ISP any information that affects the safety of the medicines and apply for the corresponding modification of the registration, as set out in the Regulation of the National System for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use.

rows.quote: Todo titular de registro sanitario de productos farmacéuticos deberá comunicar al Instituto de Salud Pública, cualquier información que afecte la seguridad de los medicamentos y solicitar la modificación correspondiente de acuerdo a lo señalado en el Reglamento del Sistema Nacional de Control de Productos Farmacéuticos de Uso Humano.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Every holder of a marketing authorisation for pharmaceutical products shall communicate to the Instituto de Salud Pública any information that affects the safety of the medicines and apply for the corresponding modification in accordance with the Regulation of the National System for the Control of Pharmaceutical Products for Human Use.

f.title: Process PV notification data under Law 19.628 on privacy
f.statement: The processing of data obtained and the results of notifications and communications under this standard are governed by Law No. 19.628 on the protection of private life, with due safeguarding of professional secrecy by officials who have access to this information, an obligation that continues after they cease their activities in the field.
f.clause: Título V De la confidencialidad, Artículo 13

rows.actor: All parties handling PV notifications (including marketing authorisation holders and officials with access)
rows.quote: El tratamiento de los datos obtenicos y el resultado de las notificaciones y comunicaciones a que alude la presente norma técnica, que se efectúan con el fin de proteger la salud de las personas, se regirán por las normas de la Ley N° 19.628, sobre protección de la vida privada
rows.location: Título V De la confidencialidad, Artículo 13
rows.review_note: Review: article is generic (applies to all processing of PV notification data); actor generalised. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: actor inferred, 84.
rows.quote_en: The processing of the data obtained and the result of the notifications and communications referred to in this technical standard, which are made in order to protect people's health, shall be governed by the rules of Law No. 19.628 on the protection of private life

f.title: Report serious adverse reactions in clinical research via the site director to ISP
f.statement: Serious adverse reactions seen in the scientific investigation of a medicine must be reported by the investigators to the Scientific Ethics Committee and to the director of the establishment where the research is carried out; the director must report them to the ISP under Articles 216 and 217 of DS 3/2010.

rows.actor: Clinical investigator and director of the trial site
rows.quote: Las reacciones agversas graves vistas en la investigación cientifica de un medicamento, deberán ser informadas por los investigadores al Comité Ético Cientifico y al Director det establecimiento donde se lleva a cabo dicha Investigación; siendo éste ultimo el que debe reportarlos al Instituto de Salud Pública
rows.review_note: Review: duty is on investigators and site directors, not the sponsor; kept as clinical-trial safety flow. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: non-company actor, 86.
rows.quote_en: Serious adverse reactions seen in the scientific investigation of a medicine shall be reported by the investigators to the Scientific Ethics Committee and to the Director of the establishment where the research is carried out, the latter being the one who must report them to the Instituto de Salud Pública
